changelog: Clarified core principle: prefer promoting safe, high-confidence boundaries rather than broadly demoting risky ones; rank adjustments should be narrow, local, and use short lookahead.
Made candidacy rules explicitly generous and surface-only; moved all lookahead checks into the ranking pass and limited them to 2–3 tokens to avoid over-demotion.
Added positive promotion signals: explicit conditions that raise a candidate to top rank when a clause is clearly complete and no short complement/subordinator follows.

Replaced blanket low/high demotions with targeted, lightweight ranking downgrades for specific risky surface patterns (verb+complement, 'between/among' participant lists, 'As TITLE' preposed roles, passive 'by' obliques, contrastive limiters), only when those patterns appear within a short lookahead window.
